internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Within the Quran the root ش م ل appears as two morphologically and semantically distinct, internally coherent classes that share no Quran-internal bridge. (1) The nominal شِمَال/شَمَائِل (10/12) means 'the left' — a lateral side/hand/direction/group defined relationally as the counterpart of يَمِين (the right); in 7 of 10 tokens يمين/أيمان stands in the same verse (34:15, 18:17, 18:18, 50:17, 70:37, 16:48, 7:17), and the other 3 (56:41 ×2, 69:25) sit in a discourse built on the same right/left pair. (2) The Form VIII verb ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَىٰ (2/12; 6:143, 6:144, one repeated formula) means 'to enclose/contain/comprise' — comprehensive interior containment (what the wombs enclose), with no directional or lateral content. The two classes not only fail to bridge but pull in opposite directions: the noun is partitive/contrastive (this side, not the other) while the verb is comprehensive/totalizing (all the contents within). No occurrence activates a shared 'covering/wrapping-to-a-side' nucleus; any nucleus broad enough to span both is a vague abstraction unsupported Quran-internally and reliant on barred external etymology. The honest result is UNRESOLVED at root level: two unbridged lexicalized classes, not one meaning.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: شِمَال does NOT carry inherent moral valence — it is morally neutral in 16:48 (shadows), 18:17/18:18 (cave orientation), 34:15 (a site of divine blessing, gardens), 50:17/70:37 (positions), 7:17 (one of four directions); the doom-association appears only where eschatological context assigns fate by side (56:41 أصحاب الشمال; 69:25 record in the left hand). شِمَال does NOT entail 'north', 'wind', or 'garment/wrapping' anywhere in the packet. The plural شَمَائِل adds only number (physical 'left sides'), not a separate sense or 'character/traits'. ٱشْتَمَلَ does NOT entail direction, laterality, or a right/left axis; and the partitive one-of-two-sides sense of شِمَال does NOT entail comprehensive enclosure. The root is not productive as a live meaning-generator here: 10/12 are one frozen directional noun and the verb is confined to a single repeated formula (6:143≈6:144).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 6:143:15:1 / 6:144:13:1 «أَمَّا ٱشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ ٱلْأُنثَيَيْنِ» is pure comprehensive containment with no lateral 'left' axis, while 34:15:10:2 «جَنَّتَانِ عَن يَمِينٍ وَشِمَالٍ» and 50:17:7:2 «عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ» are 'one of two opposed sides' with no containment — the two classes pull in opposite directions (partitive vs comprehensive) and neither reading transfers across the boundary, disproving any single unified nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single-nucleus reading 'comprehensive covering/enveloping-to-a-side', from which both 'the left (the wrapped/other side)' and 'the womb encloses' would flow (the classical شملة-garment / شمال etymological bridge). Rejected on two Quran-internal grounds: (a) it depends on external lexical priors barred by the source policy — the Quran never uses شمال for wrapping/garment and never uses ٱشتمل for 'left'; (b) the covering/enveloping sense is nowhere activated in the 10 nominal tokens, which behave purely as the يمين-opposed directional term, and 7:17's four-direction enumeration reinforces 'one discrete side', not encompassment. No bridging occurrence licenses the unity.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent analyses (Lens A bottom-up, Lens B, adversary Lens C) converge: two morphologically distinct classes (N=10 with qac_verb_form null; V(VIII)=2) with zero collocational, contextual, or morphological overlap and no Quran-internal bridge. Each class is internally clean (10/10 directional 'left'; 2/2 'enclose/contain'), but the root-level nucleus is the point of failure. Per contract, when two+ senses have no Quran-internal bridge, choose UNRESOLVED rather than forcing one nucleus; a vague unifying abstraction that fits everything is disallowed. The adversary additionally shows the classes are not merely non-bridging but semantically opposed (partitive vs comprehensive), which is fatal to unification. Because the honest root result is 'no unified nucleus / two unbridged lexicalized classes', result_strength=UNRESOLVED with LOCAL scope and UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY kind.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 12/12 occurrences read from Tanzil verse_text with QAC morphology: 10 nominal (شِمَال singular ×8: 18:17, 18:18, 34:15, 50:17, 56:41×2, 69:25, 70:37; شَمَائِل plural ×2: 16:48, 7:17) and 2 Form VIII verbs (6:143, 6:144).
layer_attribution.derivation: Two derivational shapes with no shared productive nucleus: a frozen فِعَال/فَعَائِل nominal (شِمَال/شَمَائِل) and a Form VIII verb (ٱشْتَمَلَ) confined to one repeated formula; morphology does not establish semantic identity across them.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Class N = lexicalized directional noun 'left', the counterpart pole of يَمِين; Class V(VIII) = lexicalized verb 'enclose/contain/comprise'. Each is internally coherent; neither is Quran-internally reducible to the other.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The negative/eschatological valence at 56:41 (أصحاب الشمال) and 69:25 (record in the left hand) is supplied by contextual right/left sorting, NOT by the lexeme (neutral or blessed elsewhere, e.g. 34:15 gardens); this contextual valence must not be read into the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary within-class CONSISTENT dispositions are retained for classification, while the four seam occurrences (6:143, 6:144, 34:15, 50:17) are finalized RESISTANT to represent the root-level non-bridge; the classes are not forced into one nucleus.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The root-level nucleus is UNRESOLVED: two unbridged, partly opposed (partitive vs comprehensive) lexicalized classes with no Quran-internal bridge; the only unification available depends on barred external etymology and is therefore rejected.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The root is genuinely unresolved: two internally coherent but unbridged (and in one respect semantically opposed) lexicalized classes. The seam occurrences — the two Form VIII containment tokens (6:143, 6:144) and the sharpest directional-partitive tokens (34:15, 50:17) — are recorded as persisting resistant material representing the mutual non-bridge that blocks any unified nucleus.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence that bridges the two classes — e.g. a nominal شِمَال/شَمَائِل token carrying an 'enclose/cover/comprise' nuance, or an ٱشتمل token carrying a left/right lateral sense — would demonstrate the missing bridge and overturn the UNRESOLVED multi-class partition in favor of a single nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The 10 nominal tokens (esp. 7:17 four-direction enumeration and 16:48 shadows) for any 'enveloping/comprehending' reading, and the 2 Form VIII tokens (6:143, 6:144) for any lateral/directional reading.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each candidate's verse_text and QAC morphology (qac_pos, qac_verb_form, form) to check whether the alleged shared sense is actually activated by the syntax and collocation, not merely importable from external etymology.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude external lexicons, tafsir, translations, and the شملة-garment/north-wind etymology (barred by source policy); require the bridging sense to be forced by in-verse Quranic context, not assumed from shared root letters.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no such bridging occurrence exists, the two-class partition stands and the root remains UNRESOLVED with no unified root contribution; if one is found, reopen and re-grade toward a single nucleus.

reopen_conditions: A nominal شِمَال or شَمَائِل occurrence (e.g. a re-reading of 7:17 شَمَآئِلِهِمْ or 16:48 ٱلشَّمَآئِل) is shown by in-verse context to carry an 'enclose/cover/comprehend' nuance rather than the يمين-opposed directional sense, supplying the missing bridge to the ٱشتمل class.

An ٱشْتَمَلَ عَلَىٰ occurrence (6:143 or 6:144) is shown to carry a left/right lateral axis, or a new Quran-internal occurrence of the root activates both directional and containment senses simultaneously, licensing a single nucleus.
New corpus evidence establishes a productive, decomposable root sense generating both the frozen directional noun and the Form VIII enclosure verb without recourse to external lexical priors.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: No unified root-level claim is asserted (candidate_root_contribution=null), so root-level falsification is NOT_REQUIRED. The adversarial pass instead confirmed the absence of a bridge: attempts to derive one class from the other fail bidirectionally (6:143/6:144 vs 34:15/50:17), and the only unifying account relies on barred external etymology.
